'''2001 Martin-Con''' was a Star Wars CCG casual in August 2001. [[Edwin Harris]] won it. It is known from Martin Warlick's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2874">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-20-martin-con-01d2874/ martin-con-01], DeckTech (Martin "psycho_loser" Warlick, 20 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-20-martin-con-01d2874/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' August 2001
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Players:''' 4
* '''Winner:''' [[Edwin Harris]]
